ports.name: Windows x64
ports.summary: Playable: campaign and local Wi-Fi matches, 240 fps, launcher; HD textures in progress.

Every instruction incl. Thumb, differential tests against Unicorn
Runtime: libc, pthreads, heap, setjmp, C++ exceptions
Fake JNI / Java, Android lifecycle, GLES2 on ANGLE
Audio (Vox AudioTrack on SDL3)
Launcher, nova3.ini, display modes, VSync, FOV, Saved Games
Keyboard / mouse and gamepad controls, menus without touch
Campaign playable: loading, tutorials, QTEs, slow motion, section loads
Offline game: store, ads, social, logins removed
Local Wi-Fi multiplayer (LAN / ZeroTier peers)
HD texture pack: upscaled textures swapped in at upload (work in progress)
Performance pass (flow analysis, inlining, native hot paths, PGO)
Linux build (tested once, Ubuntu 24.04 in WSL)
Physical gamepad, grenade / melee keys, uncapped fps tested
Translated functions replaced with readable C++

Steady 60 fps on hardware (52-56 before the last pass)
libnx controller, touchscreen and keyboard paths verified

No pause when changing weapons
Local multiplayer between consoles
